profile.summary: Surana Telecom and Power Limited engages in the generation of renewable energy in India. The company operates through Renewable Energy (Solar & Wind); and Trading & Others segments. It is involved in the trading of solar related products; wind power generation; and infrastructure leasing. The company also provides cable, solar photovoltaic, aluminum rods, jelly filled cables, CDMA mobile handsets,
